description: Parking Spaces is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. The number of marked out controlled on and off-street parking spaces. The information is published annually. The list is for information only. Amendments to on street parking restrictions are ongoing. It is the driver's responsibility to ensure that they park in accordance with the restrictions in force on the street at the time of parking. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Parking and Mobility. Its keywords are On-street, Off-street, Car Parking, Parking, Transparency. The portal shows 723 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
